name: Medicare for All
description: Single-payer health care. Full marks for a cosponsor or a candidate who campaigns on it by name; partial for a public option or Medicare expansion.

rubric.0: Opposes or dodges; defends private insurance status quo
rubric.2: Backs a public option or Medicare buy-in
rubric.3: Supports single payer but hedges on timeline or bill
rubric.4: Cosponsors or campaigns on Medicare for All by name

name: Green New Deal / climate
description: Climate action at the scale of the Green New Deal: public investment, end fossil fuel subsidies, no new leases, a just transition.

rubric.0: Fossil fuel money, pro-drilling, or climate skeptic
rubric.2: Backs IRA-style incentives, no fossil fuel phaseout
rubric.3: Supports ending subsidies and new leasing
rubric.4: Cosponsors or campaigns on the Green New Deal

name: Labor and the PRO Act
description: Union rights: PRO Act, sectoral bargaining, $17+ minimum wage, walks picket lines.

rubric.2: Supports $15 minimum wage and PRO Act in principle
rubric.3: Cosponsor of PRO Act, visible with strikes
rubric.4: PRO Act plus sectoral bargaining, $17+ wage, union-led campaign

name: Rejects corporate PAC money
description: Whether the campaign takes corporate PAC, crypto super PAC, or AIPAC-aligned money.

rubric.0: Takes corporate PAC money and benefits from AIPAC/crypto super PACs
rubric.2: No corporate PAC pledge, but lobbyist or super PAC support
rubric.3: No corporate PAC pledge, small-dollar heavy
rubric.4: No corporate PAC, no lobbyist money, disavows outside super PAC spending

name: Gaza ceasefire and arms conditions
description: Position on Israel's war in Gaza: ceasefire, conditioning or blocking offensive arms, opposing AIPAC influence.

rubric.0: Unconditional support for arms transfers; AIPAC-backed
rubric.1: Ceasefire language only after it became mainstream
rubric.2: Supports ceasefire, opposes conditions on aid
rubric.3: Supports conditioning arms and humanitarian access
rubric.4: Voted for or campaigns on blocking offensive arms transfers; refuses AIPAC

name: Housing
description: Social housing, rent stabilization, tenant protections, and zoning reform to build more.

rubric.2: Supports more building and housing vouchers
rubric.3: Supports tenant protections and public investment
rubric.4: Social housing, rent stabilization, and tenant right to counsel

name: Tax the rich
description: Wealth tax, higher top rates, corporate rate increases, closing carried interest.

rubric.2: Repeal Trump cuts for top earners
rubric.3: Higher corporate rate plus capital gains reform
rubric.4: Wealth tax or billionaire minimum tax by name

name: Reproductive rights
description: Codify Roe, repeal Hyde, protect access to abortion medication and IVF.

rubric.4: Full access: repeal Hyde, protect mifepristone, expand clinics with federal funding

name: Immigration
description: Pathway to citizenship, ending mass deportation, accountability for ICE, no border wall funding.

rubric.0: Supports mass deportation or the Laken Riley Act framing
rubric.3: Broad pathway to citizenship, opposes wall funding
rubric.4: Pathway for all, defund or abolish ICE enforcement, end detention contracts

name: Criminal justice
description: Police accountability, ending qualified immunity, decarceration, cannabis legalization.

rubric.0: 'Tough on crime' platform, backs more police funding without reform
rubric.2: Supports cannabis legalization and sentencing reform
rubric.3: Ends qualified immunity, backs George Floyd Act
rubric.4: Decarceration, ends cash bail, redirects police funding to services

name: Corporate power and antitrust
description: Break up monopolies, ban stock trading in Congress, rein in Big Tech and private equity.

rubric.0: Deregulation agenda, tech and finance donor base
rubric.3: Supports antitrust enforcement, breaking up Big Tech
rubric.4: Breakups plus private equity and crypto regulation, no industry money

name: Democracy reform
description: Abolish the filibuster, overturn Citizens United, expand voting rights, Supreme Court reform.

rubric.2: Supports ending the filibuster for voting rights
rubric.3: End the filibuster, overturn Citizens United
rubric.4: All of that plus Supreme Court term limits or expansion
